crime: When {WITCH_NAME} was twelve, her mother read a line from her diary aloud to her: she had pictured her sister under the bathwater. From then on, every morning, her mother held her face and searched it before letting her anywhere near her sister.
So she learned to use her Magic before anyone could look at her. She touched her temple and drew the thought out as a glass bead, and her face had nothing left to show.

In the prison, one girl sat by the courtyard fountain every evening and read the prisoners' faces, holding each one in both hands. She kept asking {WITCH_NAME} to sit in front of her. It was the only face she could never read.
Then, one evening at the fountain, she read it before the bead could come out. "You pictured holding me under," she said. "I'll read you every evening from now on, so you never hide it again."

The next evening, before the reading, {WITCH_NAME} set a crossbow on the upper railing and aimed it at the girl's seat by the fountain. She cocked it and rested the string on a bead of thought drawn from her temple.

At the reading, she sat down in front of the girl and took the thought back. The bead was gone from behind the string. The crossbow fired down from the railing and put a bolt into the girl's back. The prisoners saw the shot come from an empty railing while {WITCH_NAME}'s face was still held in the girl's hands.

In the trial court, a prisoner found a dent the size of a bead in the notch that holds the crossbow's drawn string. A bead of thought had held the string there, she said, and it was gone the moment {WITCH_NAME} took the thought back.
fields.epitaph: The thought was only ever glass, until she took it back.
fields.epithet: A face emptied before every glance
execution: The execution stand strapped her upright between two iron hands. They closed around her face from either side and cupped it toward the spectators, holding it up to be read.
Then the iron palms pressed inward on her temples. The squeeze came slowly and did not let up.
At last she hung still in the iron hands, her face still turned toward the spectators.

magic.name: Glass Thoughts
magic.text: She can draw her thoughts out of her head as glass beads and take them back whenever she wants.
